name: pix-on
eval: (()=>{window.__tod='night'; window.__weather='clear'; d.sky.aurora(true); window.__noSky=false; return { c: [-3200, -900, 300], t: [-3200, -1700, 330], fov: 75 };})()

name: pix-off
eval: (()=>{window.__tod='night'; window.__weather='clear'; d.sky.aurora(true); window.__noSky=true; return { c: [-3200, -900, 300], t: [-3200, -1700, 330], fov: 75 };})()

name: moon-crescent
eval: (()=>{window.__noSky=false; window.__tod='night'; window.__weather='clear'; d.sky.aurora(false); d.sky.moon(0.15); return { c: [-3828, -1438, 1.6], t: [-3744, -1338, 85], fov: 18 };})()
